design: fail-closed: check_partition_allowed() raises PartitionAccessViolation BEFORE load_model_v2_partition() ever calls np.load(); existing V1 loaders (datasets/*, evaluation/*) are untouched -- this is a purely additive wrapper
ledger_format: append-only JSON Lines; one row per successful access: timestamp_utc, stage_id, experiment_id, partition, access_type, rows, source_path, git_sha
fail_closed_proof: each forbidden-partition test uses a deliberately nonexistent source_path and asserts the file was never created/touched (assert not nonexistent.exists()) and no ledger row was written -- proving the denial happens strictly before any file I/O, not merely before returning success

actual_v2_001_data_access_performed.note: V2-001 itself performs no waveform access as part of generating its own evidence -- Sections 10/11 (CV/inner manifests) derive folds from already-frozen TRAIN metadata counts (manifests/splits/*, reports/t013/window_distribution.json) and never open a single .npy waveform file.
